'''Clay Cushman''' is a Star Wars CCG player who played at [[2000 Dagobah Regionals]] on 29 July 2000 with [[Court Of The Vile Gangster / I Shall Enjoy Watching You Die|Court of Big Beats]], according to Adam Beauchamp's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d1071">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-dagobah-regionals-july-29-2000d1071/ dagobah-regionals-july-29-2000], DeckTech (Adam "Vincent Vega" Beauchamp, 31 July 2000). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2000-07-31-dagobah-regionals-july-29-2000d1071/ GitHub Pages].</ref>
